Summary: ManuRAG4 is the highest variant in terms of semantic similarity for MCQ tasks, achieving a score of 96.82% (source: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2601.15434). It also outperforms other models in ROUGE scores for MCQs, with a score of 86.77% (source: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2601.15434). The Semantic Similarity metric evaluates the resemblance between a generated response and a reference answer, using embeddings and cosine similarity (source: https://docs.ragas.io/en/stable/concepts/metrics/available_metrics/semantic_similarity).
